observations.behavior: Adds a paragraph describing the Search tab ranking and decision-model reranking, including the two-second budget and fallback behavior.
observations.code_quote: The Search tab ranks observations by embedding distance, then a decision model rereads the query and each of the top 20 together and reorders them by how well they match. The reorder has a two-second budget, and search falls back to the embedding order when the model is slow, failing, or not configured.
